$comment: Regulator-correlation source specification: https://data.igvf.org/documents/e204bbb2-3249-499f-bfc8-0e0ab38cc3a4/ This catalog schema covers its promoter-targeting subset. GRCh38/hg38 is specified there; the 0-based, end-exclusive interpretation was confirmed separately by the data owner and is not asserted by this PDF.

_key.description: CRISPR interval, GRCh38 assembly, regulator gene, and upstream regulator file accession (also when parsed from downstream correlations). Gene-specific keys preserve distinct promoter annotations for shared intervals.

start.description: Start of a source hg38 interval. Stored as 0-based using the data-owner-confirmed coordinate convention.

end.description: End of a source hg38 interval. Stored as end-exclusive using the data-owner-confirmed coordinate convention.

source_annotation.title: Source Annotation
source_annotation.description: Perturbed element category from genomic_element (regulator results) or genomic_element_1 / genomic_element_2 (correlations). The source standard permits promoters, enhancers, and other types; this catalog implementation currently supports promoters.

promoter_of.title: Promoter Of
promoter_of.description: Catalog gene for the promoter-targeted regulator, derived from its GENCODE v43 Ensembl ID. The regulator-correlation standard requires a gene ID for promoter-targeting regulators.

accessible_via.return: _id, name, chr, start, end, type, source_annotation, promoter_of, biosample_term, biological_context, treatments_term_ids, perturbation, files_filesets, class, method, label, source, source_url
